correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the polytope from Behrend et al. Proposition 2.8 and verified simplex Dirichlet tails m!Vol({sum_I x_i>h})=sum_{j<|I|} binom(m,j) h^j(S-h)^(m-j). Single-coordinate forbidden caps have normalized volume A^m, pair cap intersection (B-1)^m. Integrating the two-coordinate facet violation with both caps gives (m-B)B^(m-1)+(B-1)^m. Bonferroni cancellation removes pair cap intersections exactly. Pair-pair and pair-cap overlaps have residual <C; higher rank k>=3 have residual <=C and at most O_n(m^(2n-3)) multiplicity. This proves the stated error for fixed n>=5; C/B<1 proves the ratio limit. Independently checked pair integral by exact arithmetic/numerical integration; finite hull computations do not prove asymptotics.
